grammar.title: Imperative for Emergencies and the Subjunctive with 'Es urgente que'
grammar.explanation:
In emergencies, you need both imperative commands and subjunctive constructions:

Imperative (direct commands):
• ¡Llame a la policía! - Call the police! (usted)
• ¡No se mueva! - Don't move! (usted)
• ¡Ayúdeme! - Help me!
• ¡Salga del edificio! - Get out of the building!

Subjunctive with urgency expressions:
• Es urgente que + subjunctive: Es urgente que llegue la ambulancia. (It's urgent that the ambulance arrive.)
• Es necesario que + subjunctive: Es necesario que evacuen el edificio. (It's necessary that they evacuate the building.)

Negative usted commands use the subjunctive form: ¡No entre! (Don't enter!)
